exposure: moderate to severe BPD at 36 weeks postmenstrual age
outcome: short-term outcomes (resource utilization, survival to discharge)
cohort: Preterm infants born at less than 32 weeks gestation between August 2013 and July 2015 with moderate to severe BPD at 36 weeks postmenstrual age
finding: Approximately 28% of infants with moderate to severe BPD had PH, but no significant risk factors for PH were identified, and there were no differences in short-term outcomes between infants with and without PH.
